nodes.description: Public token symbol state variable set to "WC" at deployment.
Public token name state variable set to "WenCoinbase".
Public token decimals state variable set to 18.
Private total token supply (1e27) that is reduced by burn amounts on every transfer.
Constant 100 used as the basis for the ceil/fee computation in findOnePercent.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; written by approve and consumed/decremented by transferFrom.
Deployment constructor that mints the whole _totalSupply to msg.sender and emits a Transfer from address(0).
View function returning the current _totalSupply.
View function returning balances[holder].
View function returning allowed[holder][spender].
Private helper computing the burn fee as ceil(amount,100)*100/1000 using SafeMath.
Transfers tokens to a recipient, burns a one-percent fee and reduces _totalSupply accordingly.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = amount without validating the spender or resetting the allowance to zero first.
Spends an allowance, moves tokens from 'from' to 'to', burns a fee and decrements the allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, balance debits, allowance ownership and allowance spending.
Rounding arithmetic (ceil + mul + div) that computes the burned fee; rounding direction can silently over-charge users.
State mutation of balances[msg.sender], balances[to] and _totalSupply inside transfer using SafeMath sub/add.
State mutation of balances[from], balances[to], _totalSupply and allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
Unconditional overwrite of allowed[msg.sender][spender] enabling the classic approve/transferFrom race.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer, checked against balances[msg.sender].
Local variable holding the fee returned by findOnePercent inside transfer.
Local variable holding amount minus the burned fee inside transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Owner address parameter of transferFrom whose balance and allowance are debited.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, checked against balance and allowance.
Local variable holding the fee returned by findOnePercent inside transferFrom.
Local variable holding amount minus the burned fee inside transferFrom.
Rounded-up amount produced by the SafeMath ceil helper inside findOnePercent.
Computed burn value roundAmount*100/1000 returned by findOnePercent.
Amount parameter passed into findOnePercent.
Holder address parameter of balanceOf.
Holder address parameter of allowance.
Spender address parameter of allowance.

edges.reason: _totalSupply is read by the constructor to mint the entire supply to the deployer.
totalSupply() returns the _totalSupply state variable.
transfer decrements _totalSupply by tokensToBurn after every transfer.
transferFrom decrements _totalSupply by the burned fee.
findOnePercent uses oneHundredPercent as the fee basis.
Constructor writes the initial balance into the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads balances[holder].
transfer reads and writes balances for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for 'from' and 'to'.
allowance reads allowed[holder][spender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom checks and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
The deployer (msg.sender) receives the entire minted supply, making the caller the privileged owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and authorises the transfer purely from caller identity.
approve grants an allowance to the spender keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
transferFrom consumes an allowance owned by the untrusted msg.sender.
transfer calls findOnePercent to compute the burn fee.
transferFrom calls findOnePercent to compute the burn fee.
findOnePercent performs ceil/mul/div rounding arithmetic that determines the fee burned from users.
transfer performs SafeMath subtraction and addition on balances and total supply.
transferFrom performs SafeMath subtraction and addition on balances, allowance and total supply.
approve unconditionally overwrites the allowance slot, the unsafe write of the function.
The 'to' parameter is the recipient whose balance is credited in transfer.
The amount parameter drives the balance checks and the burn computation in transfer.
transfer stores the findOnePercent result in the tokensToBurn local variable.
transfer stores amount minus the fee in the tokensToTransfer local variable.
tokensToBurn feeds the _totalSupply subtraction and the burn Transfer event.
tokensToTransfer feeds the recipient balance addition in transfer.
The spender parameter is the key of the allowance written by approve.
The amount parameter is written verbatim into the allowance slot by approve.
The 'from' parameter is the address whose balance and allowance are debited in transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is the recipient credited in transferFrom.
The amount parameter is validated against balance and allowance in transferFrom.
transferFrom stores the findOnePercent result in tokensToBurn.
transferFrom stores amount minus the fee in tokensToTransfer.
tokensToBurn drives the total supply burn and event emission in transferFrom.
tokensToTransfer drives the recipient balance addition in transferFrom.
findOnePercent stores the rounded amount in roundAmount.
findOnePercent stores the computed fee in fivePercent and returns it.
roundAmount is multiplied and divided to derive the burn fee.
fivePercent is the rounded burn fee returned by the arithmetic operation.
The amount parameter is the input to the fee computation in findOnePercent.
The holder parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The holder parameter is the first key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
The spender parameter is the second key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
